article.headline: Frazier has 17 as Central Connecticut takes down Wagner 62-55
article.description: — Max Frazier had 17 points in Central Connecticut's 62-55 win over Wagner on Thursday.
article.linkText: Frazier has 17 as Central Connecticut takes down Wagner 62-55

categories.description: Central Connecticut Blue Devils @ Wagner Seahawks

event.description: Central Connecticut Blue Devils @ Wagner Seahawks

keywords: Central Connecticut Blue Devils @ Wagner Seahawks
article.story: STATEN ISLAND, N.Y. -- — Max Frazier had 17 points in Central Connecticut's 62-55 win over Wagner on Thursday. Frazier shot 7 of 8 from the field and 3 of 3 from the free-throw line for the Blue Devils (11-9, 5-4 Northeast Conference). Travis Gray led the way for the Seahawks (6-13, 1-7) with 17 points. Nick Jones added 10 points for Wagner. Binael Basil finished with eight points and eight rebounds. The loss is the Seahawks’ seventh straight. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
